title: Small Plane Crashes on Monterrey–Nuevo Laredo Highway; All Six Aboard Survive
excerpt: A small plane carrying six people crashed onto the Monterrey–Nuevo Laredo highway Wednesday afternoon, Nov. 18, and caught fire — and all six people aboard survived, according to Mexican aviation and civil protection authorities.
content:
A small plane carrying six people crashed onto the Monterrey–Nuevo Laredo highway Wednesday afternoon, Nov. 18, and caught fire — and all six people aboard survived, according to Mexican aviation and civil protection authorities.

The Piper PA-46 lost power as it took off from the Aeropuerto Internacional del Norte in Apodaca, Nuevo León, veered off the runway, crossed the airport’s perimeter fence and ended up on the highway near the Salinas Victoria junction, where it burst into flames, authorities said.

The plane, operated by the company Casago, S.A. de C.V., was headed for the Aeródromo Dr. Jorge Jiménez Cantú in Atizapán, in the State of Mexico, according to Mexico’s Federal Civil Aviation Agency. The agency identified the aircraft’s Mexican registration as XB-MKC, though some early reports cited a different registration.

The six people aboard were crew members David Corona Cabrero, 41, and Alan Adrián Cuevas Loo, 25, and passengers José Luis Villaseñor Sánchez, 56; Armando Ezequiel Mata, 42; Carlos Alejandro Castillo Pérez, 40; and Priscila Guadalupe Carrillo Fragoso, 36, according to state civil protection officials.

All six were checked at the scene for minor injuries, and no one was seriously hurt, officials said. Firefighters, Red Cross paramedics and state civil protection crews put out the fire. The crash closed the highway in both directions, and the airport’s runway 11/29 was shut down while emergency crews worked the scene.

The Federal Civil Aviation Agency has opened an investigation into what caused the plane to lose power on takeoff, and early reports point to a loss of engine power during the climb.

Sources: Somos Utah, Nov. 19, 2026; Código Libre, Nov. 18, 2026.
